args: Extend the selected Total Tools POS design into a coherent operational application. Cover Sales checkout desktop and 390px phone, Inventory stock table and item detail, Purchasing orders and approvals, Receiving delivery form, Rentals issue and return, Repairs work order detail, Customers directory and credit context, Dispatch job board, Finance and Accounting ledger, Reports filters and results, Admin and Settings forms, plus Guide Me as a calm contextual task companion with a clear next action. Use the selected neutral shell, modern sans typography, fine line icons, disciplined spacing, crisp tables, purposeful cards, exact green #0B7A3E and yellow #F2D11F accents. No green sidebar, ornamental dashboard statistics, invented business functionality or generic empty panels. Keep consistent accessible focus, forms and dialogs. These are frontend design references; real certified APIs and business handlers will be retained in integration.
